crossRefs.note: When Hushai the Archite, David’s friend, had come to Absalom, Hushai said to Absalom, “Long live the king! Long live…
Ahithophel was the king’s counselor. Hushai the Archite was the king’s friend.
Absalom and all the people, the men of Israel, came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel with him.

people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Hushai
people.line: David's friend and advisor who helped him during Absalom's rebellion.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: So Hushai, David’s friend, came into the city; and Absalom came into Jerusalem.
translations.bsb: So David’s friend Hushai arrived in Jerusalem just as Absalom was entering the city.
translations.kjv: So Hushai David's friend came into the city, and Absalom came into Jerusalem.
translations.asv: So Hushai, David's friend, came into the city; and Absalom came into Jerusalem.
